items.question: Do I need to install Bazaar?
items.answer: You can start in a regular browser. The interface adapts to computers, tablets and phones. On supported devices, you can add Bazaar to your home screen as a PWA.

items.question: Can I manage more than one store?
items.answer: Yes. Your plan defines the number of stores, products and users. Bazaar supports stock by store, transfers and staff access permissions.

items.question: Can I bring my existing catalog?
items.answer: You can add products manually. Import and export are included in the two larger plans; prepare a file matching the catalog fields before importing. Contact us if you need help.

items.question: Are all integrations connected when I sign up?
items.answer: Each channel is connected and configured separately. Data exchange depends on the provider and your plan. POS hardware and fiscal services also require compatible equipment and their own setup.

items.question: What can BAAM help with?
items.answer: The assistant accepts text and voice questions about your store, such as sales over a period or popular products. It uses the data and permissions available to the current user. Check AI answers before making important business decisions.

items.question: How do I choose and pay for a plan?
items.answer: Compare limits and capabilities in the pricing section. Contact support to activate or renew your plan; public online subscription payments are not enabled yet.
